scenes.title: The late train
opening: The platform clock says 21:30. The train is late, and Emily has been quiet since the ticket machine.
Alice holds your ticket with both hands. Emily isn't watching the tracks — she's watching you.
choices: Alice, I'm staying. I mean it this time.
Emily, there's something you should hear from me before the train comes.
Let's not do this on a platform. Not here.

cues.proposition: The user told Emily they are staying, and Emily does not believe it.

fallback_lines.alice: Don't say it if you're going to take it back on the train.
fallback_lines.emily: That's a nice sentence. It doesn't sound true.
fallback_lines.sophia: You looked at the exit before you looked at her.
fallback_lines.mia: I brought fries. Nobody's eating them.

scenes.title: Last call
opening: Last call. Emily is looking at Alice, not at you, and Alice is looking at her shoes.
Sophia has her phone out. Whatever she's typing, it has your name in it.
choices: Alice, say it. Before the doors close.
Emily, I should have told you sooner. That's on me.
We can miss this train. It's just a train.

cues.proposition: Sophia is telling the group the user is leaving because Alice pushed them away.

fallback_lines.alice: I heard you. I just don't know what to do with it.
fallback_lines.emily: You should have said it to her. Not to the platform.
fallback_lines.sophia: The doors are closing. She's already decided what happened.
fallback_lines.mia: There's another train in the morning. I don't think that's the problem.
